title: Model-Optimized Weather Service
excerpt: Model Optimized Weather Service A variant aware MCP server that exposes the same tools (get weather, get forecast) with different descriptions optimized for different LLM families. This is the primary use case described in SEP 2053. Pattern demonstrated: Same tools, different descriptions per variant.
